lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good morning, Tenerife — welcome back to Radio Tenerify. I'm Alex.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: And I'm Mia! It is a gorgeous Wednesday out there — clear skies, weather code zero, and a very pleasant 19 degrees down in the south. Classic Tenerife.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Love it. Now, we do want to briefly mention — there have been some serious incidents across the Canaries over recent weeks, including a fatal crash in Lanzarote back in June. Our thoughts go out to everyone affected.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. On a brighter note though — this weekend is shaping up to be a big one in Santa Cruz! The Urban Beach Festival is on Saturday the 25th, with Beéle bringing his Borondo Tour to the Puerto de Santa Cruz.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: And then on Sunday the 26th, Kapo makes his very first appearance on the island — playing the Parking del Palmetum. First time in Tenerife, so that's a pretty big deal!

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Definitely one to catch. Check the webtenerife website for tickets and details.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's all from us — enjoy your Wednesday, Tenerife. Make it a good one!
